text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Flower. For your
present, I
attempted to bake those
desserts you like.
However...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I do not know why, but the moment I
initiated
contact with the oven, it ceased
to function
entirely. The mission ended
in failure. My
sincerest apologies...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, it's not your fault. Don't be too
hard on
yourself, Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A backup plan must be drafted at the
current
juncture. I will accept any input,
as long as it is
from you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My... input? Hmm... Um... Then how
about...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
How about you join me in roasting some

marshmallows to eat? We can use a grill
instead
of an oven, so you shouldn't run
into any issues,
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Orders received. However... Is today not
your
birthday, Flower? Can I really
partake in the
consumption of
marshmallows?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
O-of course you can! And actually, um,
I... like
watching you eat.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You know how you blow on hot foods
before you
eat them? I think it's really
cute. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reassurance acknowledged—adding that
cooling
operations are considered cute
to database.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Database updated... Heat detected in cheeks. Blow...
